topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: This city, it grinds you down, eats at the edges of what little you've got left till there's nothing but clipped edges and sharp words. Me, I'm used to it. But this? This neighbor, asking for a piece of what little space I've got to plant his damn flowers or vegetables or whatever? Can’t he see I’ve got just enough room for my car, not some wannabe farm? People, they start off small, asking for a little, then before you know it, they’re over the line, and your space, it's just a little bit smaller. No thanks. I’ve got my ways, my space, and I’ll be damned if I give it up for anyone.
